Do you have a history of vitamin B12 deficiency or pernicious anemia?
Do you experience a resting tremor in your hands?
Have you noticed that your movements have become slower over the past year?
Do you have any trouble with urinary incontinence?
Do you experience dizziness or a spinning sensation (vertigo)?
Has your vision noticeably worsened recently?

Do you drink more than two alcoholic beverages a day?

results: 1. I will observe your gait walking down the hallway right now.
gait examination: wide-based, unsteady gait
2. I will perform the Romberg test (standing with feet together, eyes closed).
Romberg test: negative - swaying is not worse with the eyes closed
3. I will perform the tandem gait test (walking heel-to-toe).
gait examination: wide-based, unsteady gait
4. I will test your rapid alternating movements in your hands.
coordination examination (limb and truncal): limb and truncal ataxia
5. I will check your reflexes in your knees and ankles.
deep tendon reflexes and plantar responses: normal
6. I will check sensation in your feet with a tuning fork (vibration sense).
sensory examination (pinprick, vibration, proprioception): normal
7. I will check your blood pressure lying down and standing up.
vital signs: normal, afebrile
8. I will order a basic metabolic panel (including electrolytes and kidney function).
serum electrolytes, urea and creatinine: normal
9. I will order a complete blood count (CBC).
full blood count: normal
10. I will order a thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) level.
TSH / free T4: normal
11. I will order a vitamin B12 level.
vitamin B12 / folate: normal
12. I will order a hemoglobin A1c to check for diabetes.
glucose / HbA1c: normal
blood glucose and HbA1c: normal
13. I will order an MRI of the brain.
brain MRI: cerebellar atrophy on sagittal T1 and axial FLAIR
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Sporadic adult-onset cerebellar ataxia (idiopathic cerebellar degeneration).

ALTERNATIVES:
Hereditary spinocerebellar ataxia (e.g., SCA 6)
Multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C)
Toxic or paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration
